sub_sector.value: classic and collector vehicle insurance; enthusiast auctions and marketplaces; membership and media

financial_business_type.detail: Specialty collector car insurance, policies written by partner carriers with Hagerty setting risk acceptance; plus marketplace, membership and media.

revenue_driver.detail: Commissions and fees on policies placed with partner carriers, plus premiums on reinsured risk, auctions, membership and events.

customer_type.detail: Car enthusiasts and collectors, plus specialty business coverage for event, marine and automotive businesses.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Policies mostly underwritten by partner carriers; Hagerty handles risk acceptance and carries limited risk through reinsurance.
